source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note the exact date and time when the safety audit took place.
3. List the specific areas and processes that were audited.
4. Record the names and positions of all personnel directly involved in the audit, both auditors and auditees.
5. Detail each failure point – specify what regulation, standard, or company policy was not met and describe the non-conformance explicitly.
6. Provide photographs or other visual evidence where possible.
7. Include the auditors' comments and observations in their exact wording.
8. Document any discussions, explanations, and justifications provided by plant management or staff during or immediately after the audit.
9. Note any immediate corrective actions taken or promised by the company at the time of the audit.
10. Capture the overall assessment of the audit, including whether it led to a passing or failing grade.
11. Mention any recommended follow-up inspections or audits.
12. Compile all documentation and send it to relevant stakeholders, such
